title: Wan 2.1 VACE overlay inpaint
description: Takes app overlays off a clip: the still pixels inside an aligned mask are re-painted with the colour measured around them, and every pixel outside the mask is the source's own. The server runs this itself with a mask it measured per clip (server/video-overlay-mask.ts) as part of a clean source; it is not a picker workflow.

controls.label: What the masked area becomes
controls.default: Empty background that matches the scene.

controls.label: Negative prompt
controls.default: blurry, distorted, unstable, text, watermark, logo
